clips.send: Send to a friend convinced their manifesting isn't working - the heart attack story that reframes the setback as the delivery, pure chills.
clips.caption:
A friend wanted to quit smoking. Kevin worked with him on it - the visualization, the attractor field - and nothing happened. He kept smoking exactly like before.

Then came the heart attack. Days in intensive care where lighting a cigarette wasn't even possible, and a doctor's question about his five daughters did what willpower never could.

The universe doesn't always deliver what you pictured. Sometimes it delivers the result, by a route you would never have chosen and could never have planned yourself.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to tell a block from a gift.

#manifestation #lawofattraction #universe #awakening #subconscious #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send to a friend facing a loss they can't explain - the prison story that turns the worst thing into exactly what he asked for, a strange relief.
clips.caption:
He asked the universe for a clean slate - a way out of businesses he could never walk away from himself. He didn't ask it to look like this.

What came back was a federal courtroom, a contempt charge, and eight years taken away. Kevin says he laughed when it happened, because underneath the shock he recognized the method.

What looks like the worst thing that ever happened to you may be the only way you were ever going to get free.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to spot it while it's still happening.

#manifestation #awakening #universe #mindset #subconscious #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send to a friend white-knuckling a hard season - the one-road-to-paradise story, for the comfort of being told the bumps are normal.
clips.caption:
He pictured a smooth drive to paradise - a cold drink, a few stops, maybe some fresh mango along the way. What he got was three hours on a dirt road in a Jeep with no doors.

This is the only road to Hana, his friend told him. It's also the only road to paradise. Every mile of it was bumpy, and when he finally arrived, the bumps were the part worth remembering.

Stop expecting the road to the thing you want to be smooth. Release the grip, and let the universe choose the route.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of the teaching.

#manifestation #universe #awakening #mindset #subconscious #kevintrudeau

clips.send: Send to a friend who reacts to every single trigger - the two-step rule for what to do instead, a jolt of recognition.
clips.caption:
Something triggers you. You react, you resist, you push it away - and somehow it keeps coming back, a little bigger every time.

Kevin's rule has two steps. First, acknowledge exactly what you're feeling, without denying it or reframing it. Second, welcome it instead of fighting it, because what you resist will persist. Every adversity you're handed is carrying the seeds of something better, whether you can see it yet or not.

The universe isn't doing this to you. Most people are just asleep to that.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the two steps in full.

#subconscious #awakening #universe #mindset #manifestation #kevintrudeau
